options.content: **Holistic NOC glance** — infra health · front-door reachability · upstream carriers · live call KPIs. 🟢 = healthy. Expand a zone for per-VM detail or **Fleet resources** for CPU/mem/disk; hover any panel's ⓘ for notes. Voice tiles read from CDRs — a quiet period shows gray/‘—’ (no recent calls), not an error.

panels.title: East · us-east1
panels.description: East datacenter health = East VMs reporting hypervisor CPU (0..5). Expected 5: poc-custom-voip, kam-g2, fs-media-v2, services, east-db-standby. 🟢 5/5 · 🔴 any missing / whole DC 'DOWN'. ~5-min smoothed.

panels.title: West · us-west1
panels.description: West datacenter health = West VMs reporting CPU (0..4). Expected 4: west-sbc-1, west-sbc-2, west-fs, west-db (west-loadtest is a test rig, unmonitored). 🟢 4/4 · 🔴 any missing / 'DOWN'.

panels.title: Central · us-central1
panels.description: Central datacenter health = Central VMs reporting CPU (0..4). Expected 4: central-sbc-1, central-sbc-2, central-fs, central-db. 🟢 4/4 · 🔴 'DOWN'.

panels.title: East SIP VIP
panels.description: Uptime-check pass-fraction for the East SIP VIP (Bandwidth → NLB 34.24.133.82:5060). 🟢 ≥ 99.9% · 🟠 ≥ 99% · 🔴 failing. Carrier reachability INTO East.

panels.title: West SIP VIP
panels.description: Uptime-check pass-fraction for the West SIP VIP (NLB 35.252.214.40:5060). 🟢 ≥ 99.9%.

panels.title: Central SIP VIP
panels.description: Uptime-check pass-fraction for the Central SIP VIP (NLB 35.253.133.230:5060). 🟢 ≥ 99.9%.

panels.title: API / UI front door
panels.description: Uptime-check pass-fraction for the East services VM (34.26.57.37) serving the REST API + operator UI. 🟢 ≥ 99.9%. The only non-SIP front door.

panels.title: Bandwidth Dallas · primary
panels.description: Answer-seizure ratio for calls egressing via Bandwidth Dallas (67.231.2.12) in the last hour. 🔴 near-0 = carrier rejecting/failing calls · 🟢 normal PSTN ASR (~35–70%). '—' = no calls via Dallas recently. CDR-derived recent egress health (reactive — reflects calls actually placed; a proactive Kamailio-dispatcher OPTIONS-probe monitor is a planned follow-up).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*),0) AS asr FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND carrier_used = 'carrier_primary';

panels.title: Bandwidth LA · secondary
panels.description: Answer-seizure ratio for calls egressing via Bandwidth LA (216.82.238.134) in the last hour. 🔴 near-0 = carrier failing · 🟢 normal. A jump in LA volume with Dallas at 0 usually means failover off the primary. '—' = no calls via LA. CDR-derived recent egress health (reactive — reflects calls actually placed; a proactive Kamailio-dispatcher OPTIONS-probe monitor is a planned follow-up).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*),0) AS asr FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND carrier_used = 'carrier_secondary';

panels.title: Carrier egress · calls 1h
panels.description: Off-net calls that used a Bandwidth carrier (Dallas or LA) in the last hour — i.e. traffic leaving the platform to the PSTN. On-net (internal) calls are excluded. Informational.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND carrier_used IN ('carrier_primary','carrier_secondary');

panels.title: Call volume · 15m
panels.description: Total calls (all zones/products) seized in the last 15 minutes. Informational — a live pulse of platform traffic. 0 during quiet periods is normal on this pre-beta box.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '15 minutes';

panels.title: CPS · peak 1h
panels.description: Peak calls-per-second over the last hour (max of per-minute rate across all zones). 🟠 ≥ 350 · 🔴 ≥ 500 (soft per-zone capacity). CDR-derived.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(max(cps),0) AS cps FROM (SELECT count(*)::float/60.0 AS cps FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', start_time)) s;

panels.title: MOS · 15m avg
panels.description: Average MOS of rated calls in the last 15 minutes. 🟢 ≥ 4.0 · 🟠 ≥ 3.6 · 🔴 < 3.6. '—' = no rated calls (RTP quality is only present on calls the media server scored; capture may be off on the RCF path — a known follow-up).

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(mos) AS mos FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND mos IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Packet loss · 15m avg
panels.description: Average packet-loss %% of rated calls in the last 15 minutes. 🟢 < 1%% · 🟠 < 3%% · 🔴 ≥ 3%%. '—' = no rated calls (same RTP-capture dependency as MOS).

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(packet_loss_pct) AS loss FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND packet_loss_pct IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: East VMs
panels.description: Live East hosts — one green tile per VM currently reporting hypervisor CPU. Expected: poc-custom-voip, kam-g2, fs-media-v2, services, east-db-standby. A **missing** tile = that VM is down; the 'East' counter above is the authoritative up/down (GCM emits no series for a dead VM).

panels.title: West VMs
panels.description: Live West hosts — one green tile per VM currently reporting hypervisor CPU. Expected: west-sbc-1, west-sbc-2, west-fs, west-db. A **missing** tile = that VM is down; the 'West' counter above is the authoritative up/down (GCM emits no series for a dead VM).

panels.title: Central VMs
panels.description: Live Central hosts — one green tile per VM currently reporting hypervisor CPU. Expected: central-sbc-1, central-sbc-2, central-fs, central-db. A **missing** tile = that VM is down; the 'Central' counter above is the authoritative up/down (GCM emits no series for a dead VM).

panels.title: Fleet resources — CPU / memory / disk (all VMs)
CPU % — by VM
panels.description: Last-value CPU utilisation per VM (hypervisor metric). Hottest first; amber ≥ 70%, red ≥ 90% (fraction 0-1).

panels.title: Memory % used — by VM
panels.description: Last-value memory % used per VM (Ops Agent). VMs without the agent do not appear; amber ≥ 80%, red ≥ 90%.

panels.title: Disk % used — by VM (max real FS)
panels.description: Worst real-FS disk % used per VM (Ops Agent, REDUCE_MAX across mounts); amber ≥ 75%, red ≥ 85%.

title: Infrastructure
description: Holistic glance-first NOC board: datacenter health, front-door reachability, upstream carrier connections, and live call KPIs up top; VM + resource drilldowns collapsed below.
